_about: Data for the Chai tray (js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js). `station`: its name, goal and one goal line per phase. `words`: English placeholders for half and full until the family gives the Kutchi. `mechanic.levels`: the tray's own settings (who and what the order asks for is in the chai recipe's slots, by level: 1 = one cup, 2 = two people, 3 = three people plus extras and half/full). lines: where the dashed lines sit in a cup (the same on every cup, so they never answer the order); tolerance: how close to a line counts as on it; halfLine: draw the half line too (both lines, never only the asked one); extras: the bowls for elchi/ginger and their look-alike (shown whenever extras are possible, asked for or not); decoys: the look-alikes beside the sugar; boilLevel: the back burner's boil level (its tray profile is in mechanics.boil).

station.name: Chai tray
station.goal: Each person says how they like their chai. Give each cup what its person asked for, and turn the burner down before it boils over!

phases.water: Hold the jug: water into the pan, up to the dashed line.
phases.tea: Add the tea to the pan.
phases.knob: Tap the big knob to light the burner.
phases.cups: Tap a cup. Give it what that person asked for.
phases.pour: Tap a cup, then hold the pan to pour. Then the tick.
